cause: GSAP CSSPlugin auto-rounded strokeDashoffset to integer CSS pixels while SVG pathLength was 1. The highlighted dash stayed at the origin and then disappeared instead of traversing.
fix: Animate normalized stroke-dashoffset through SVG attr values, retaining fractional interpolation.
Use dasharray .11 2 to prevent a repeated dash wrapping back to its origin at the endpoint.
Apply the same fix to Mind→Act and Act→Mind.
